name: mirage
text: Got it, thanks. By hand, then. That means each tap re-read the price just before ordering, and the Bet sheet still showed an offer, so the misses are most likely offers disappearing in the moment between the check and the order. That's Novig's book, not stale data on our side. What I still need from the log is why a missed bet reappears in the list right away. I'll find that in your next saved report.
